title: Sperm Whales Have a Click Alphabet. Scientists Just Found It
subject: sperm whale

scenes.text: Sperm whales may be talking in an alphabet.
They click in short bursts called codas. Each one is between three and forty clicks.
For decades, scientists mostly counted the clicks. A 2024 study of nearly 9,000 recorded codas found much more.
Whales also change the tempo, the rhythm, and sometimes add one extra click at the end.
Mix those together and you get 156 distinct codas, like letters that could build into words.
No one knows what any of it means yet. The whales are keeping the secret.

description:
